findings.claim: IRAK4 inhibition substantially reduced cytokine and MMP release from RA FLS under TLR stimulation
findings.quote: As depicted in Figure  2B , PF‐06650833 substantially reduced cytokine and matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) release in response to all ligands profiled.
findings.where: RA FLS, TLR ligands Pam3Cys TLR1/2, LPS TLR4, flagellin TLR5, 100 nM

findings.quote: However, it did not inhibit IL‐1–induced cytokines in RA FLS.

findings.claim: RA fibroblast-like synoviocytes were incubated with the IRAK4 inhibitor directly
findings.quote: Human RA fibroblast‐like synoviocytes (FLS) were incubated with inhibitors, and stimulatory ligands added. Supernatants were analyzed with a Meso Scale Discovery assay kit.
findings.where: RA FLS, inhibitor plus stimulatory ligands, Meso Scale readout

findings.claim: Under IL-1beta the MMP response WAS IRAK4-kinase dependent - the readout, not the stimulus, decides
findings.quote: Intriguingly, PF‐06650833 was able to block MMP induction by IL‐1β: the first response to IL‐1β in nonhematopoietic cells we have found to be IRAK4 kinase dependent.
findings.where: RA FLS, IL-1beta stimulation, MMP readout

findings.claim: IRAK4/PIM1 inhibition blocks the TLR/MyD88 NF-kB axis
findings.quote: We confirmed that KIC-compounds suppressed luciferase expression in a dose-dependent manner in reporter cells

findings.claim: Fibroblast aggressiveness measured directly with proper controls
findings.quote: The invasiveness of RA SFs in Matrigel matrices was measured in organoid cultures.
findings.where: RA SF, Matrigel organoid invasion, OA SF and dermal fibroblast controls

findings.claim: MyD88 dimerization inhibition acts on RA synovial fibroblasts directly
findings.quote: we elucidated the effect of disrupting MyD88 dimerization by ST2825 on the pathological properties of synovial fibroblasts from RA patients (RA SFs).
findings.where: synovial fibroblasts from RA patients, LPS-activated TLR signalling

findings.claim: MyD88 dimerization is the pivotal node of the innate-immunity axis in RA
findings.quote: Dimerization of the myeloid differentiation primary response 88 protein (MyD88) plays a pivotal role in the exacerbated response to innate immunity-dependent signaling in rheumatoid arthritis (RA).
findings.where: RA synovial fibroblasts, LPS-activated TLR signalling

findings.claim: NF-kB signalling in fibroblast-like synoviocytes drives chronic inflammation - asserted as background, not tested here
findings.quote: Moreover, aberrant NF- κ B signaling in fibroblast-like synoviocytes causes chronic inflammation and destruction of extracellular matrix, leading to articular damage
findings.where: cited background, not measured in this paper

findings.claim: IRAK-family kinase activity in synovial fibroblasts drives chemokine secretion (IRAK1, genetic - adjacent evidence, not IRAK4 pharmacology)
findings.quote: IRAK1KD synovial fibroblasts showed reduced secretion of neutrophil chemoattractant chemokines following stimulation with IL-1β or human synovial fluids from patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and gout.
findings.where: mouse IRAK1-kinase-deficient synovial fibroblasts, IL-1beta, chemokine secretion
